verdict.rationale: Docs give a concrete self-serve merchant path: add one line of code (or use CDP SDK x402 building blocks) to require payment, receive at any wallet address (custodial, self-custody, Business, Prime), and Bazaar discovery/listing happens automatically with no registration form or API call once payments settle — confirmed live via runtime probe of the discovery endpoint. missing for 10: no independent hands-on merchant onboarding report/case study corroborating the frictionless claim beyond docs+probe, and no explicit merchant-facing 'agreement' or ToS acceptance step is documented.
